names.name: Czech Stop and Little Czech Bakery

text.what: A combination deli, bakery and convenience store on Interstate 35 in West, Texas, selling kolaches, klobasniky and strudel to about 600 people a day.
text.story:
Established in 1983 in a town designated "Home of the official Kolache of the Texas Legislature". A poster in the store counts the year's raw materials in thousands of pounds — over 1,200 pounds of cream cheese, 9,000 pounds of flour.

For a lot of Texans the Czech Stop is where the kolache and the klobasnek stop being a regional food and become a road food: the reason you take I-35 rather than another route.
text.today: Open around the clock, and busiest when the highway is.
